maya: Heads-up: found a weird UX edge when switching locale to German/Spanish. Performance badges break onto an extra line because translations lengthen filter pill labels and the pinned chip slides under the badges. Loom: https://loom.example/i18n-badges sam: saw it. Repro steps: set locale->de, open compact compare, pin version. The pill rail grows and pushes badges down. This also increases CLS. jordan: interesting catch. Options: 1) truncate pill labels with ellipsis, 2) reserve more horizontal space for badges, or 3) move badges into a collapsed details popover per-row when space is tight. ana: copy perspective: some languages will have longer words; ellipsizing could hide important filter context. Maybe use smart truncation keeping leading word + ellipsis, or show full label in the overflow popover. yi: accessibility/RTL note: Arabic/Hebrew (RTL) flips layout and our sticky pin is still left-aligned in RTL view which looks wrong. Need to support pin mirroring and ensure aria order follows visual order. rui: for screen readers we should not rely on visual order. Use aria-flowto or explicit DOM reorder for RTL so SR reads left-to-right in the current visual flow. Also ensure role=status for badges to announce metric changes. sam: CSS fallback we can add quickly: `.pill-rail { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; } .pill { text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 140px; }` Keeps single line across locales. jordan: but for small widths and long translations maybe better to collapse perf badges into a single compact icon that opens a metrics popover. Keeps toolbar stable and preserves info in the popover. ana: microcopy for the compact icon tooltip: "Performance metrics. 3 indicators." In localized strings include full expanded label in the popover so translators can convey context. yi: RTL-specific: when dir=rtl we should mirror sticky elements (pin goes to left) and ensure keyboard tab order matches visual order. Also check transform-origin for animations to avoid awkward slide directions. rui: sample aria for mirrored pin state: `
` Make sure aria-label is localized. sam: engineering constraint: moving badges into a popover needs metric fetching on open; cheap solution is client caches the latest metrics and shows them in popover instantly. jordan: idea: responsive rule: if pills total width > container width then collapse badges into popover and show +N overflow. Keeps layout deterministic across locales. maya: agreed. also we should add visual contrast check: some localized labels reduce contrast against tokens. run contrast audit for German/Spanish/French assets at 100% and 200% zoom. ai-design-bot: added a Figma frame "i18n-compare/rtl-and-badges" with states: en/de/es/rtl + condensed badge popover. maya: next steps: 1) Sam to implement single-line pill rail + ellipsis + width check to trigger badge popover (2 dev days). 2) Jordan to prototype condensed badge popover (design). 3) Yi & Rui to draft RTL/dom-reorder accessibility plan and aria examples. 4) Ana to flag localization team for translation guidance on truncated labels. 5) Run contrast checks across locales (design). sam: will add telemetry events: catalog.locale_changed, catalog.badge_popover_opened, catalog.pill_overflow_count to measure impact. jordan: small follow-up: for the popover show full pill label order and a tooltip on hover for truncated pills, localized copy included. rui: will include VoiceOver + NVDA RTL tests and ensure aria-live behaves in localized contexts. maya: thanks everyone. Minor ask: confirm the +N count excludes pinned chips and that popover declares hidden filters like "3 hidden filters" in localized strings. sam: noted. Will make counts locale-aware but numeric only (no commas) to keep consistent. jordan: :thumbsup: ayi: :eyes:
